messages.content: Get the protein sequence of human HbA1c, normal hemoglobin, and rat hemoglobin and their 3D models

So we need to call for "human HbA1c", "human hemoglobin", "rat hemoglobin". Or maybe "human hemoglobin" refers to normal hemoglobin. We'll assume "human hemoglobin" is normal. So we call for "human HbA1c", "human hemoglobin", "rat hemoglobin".

We need to set model_3d to true (default). So we can just call with protein_name. Let's do three calls.
